_comment: Step 1 placeholder recipes: one pipeline for everything made or done (GAMEPLAY_DESIGN.md §2; D110). inputs: an item or a tag with a count; tools: tags something in the pack must carry (not used up); station: a tag of a placed object within reach that must be working (a lit fire); seconds: how long it takes; outputs: items made; places: an object put into the world instead.

recipes.name: Campfire
recipes.description: A ring of stones, two logs and kindling. Burns about an hour and a half; add wood to keep it going.
